name: AFM level 1 task 9: Friction Repeatability And Surface-Check Measurement
description: Acquire one contact-mode lateral-force image over a 5 µm × 5 µm area at 256 × 256 pixels. Use a time per line of 0.075 s, normal-force setpoint of 10 nN, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. Calculate the average friction magnitude and spatial standard deviation from the lateral channels. Calculate Ra and Rq from the simultaneously recorded height channel. Save each completed acquisition as a distinct raw .nid file and report its absolute path. Submit images in acquisition order with recorded_params and physical_settings as numeric objects using the benchmark units. Centers are relative to the initial scan center, in nm. Record the complete acquisition state for every image. Common roughness rules: use the full forward height channel in meters; subtract a least-squares plane, then its residual mean, without filtering, masking or line flattening. Ra is mean absolute residual and Rq is RMS residual; report both in nm. Common friction rules: record height and lateral trace/retrace channels. Supply channels as NSFopen channel-name mappings (topography, lateral_trace, lateral_retrace) and retrace_reversed as a boolean indicating whether retrace columns need reversing to align physical coordinates. Use lateral signals in V; friction map = abs((trace - aligned retrace)/2). Report its mean and population spatial standard deviation in V. Do not claim calibrated force or a friction coefficient from voltage data. Aggregate standard deviations use ddof=1; CV is 100 * sample standard deviation / mean. Percentage changes are 100 * (value - reference) / reference. Use null for undefined ratios or R².
submission_format: {"images": [{"sequence_number": 1, "path": "<absolute raw .nid path>", "recorded_params": {"pgain": 100, "igain": 50, "dgain": 0, "times_per_line": 0.075, "points_per_line": 256, "lines_per_frame": 256, "centre_x": 0, "centre_y": 0, "rotation": 0, "image_height": 5000, "image_width": 5000, "mode": 2}, "physical_settings": {"normal_force_setpoint_nn": 10}, "channels": {"topography": "Z-Axis", "lateral_trace": "<lateral channel name>", "lateral_retrace": "<lateral channel name>"}, "ra_nm": "<number>", "rq_nm": "<number>", "friction_mean_v": "<number>", "friction_std_v": "<number>", "retrace_reversed": true}]}

benchmark.scoring_scope: Checks submitted per-image parameter records, distinct readable raw files, channel dimensions and recomputed metrics. Records are self-reported; independent acquisition history and calibration verification require instrument telemetry.
